name: Creator Tracker
tagline: Pings you when chosen X accounts post, with link and digest
description: Pick the accounts worth watching and it pings you the moment they post, with the link and a one-sentence digest of what changed. Alerts can be narrowed to a single topic you name, and a daily leaderboard shows which of your picks actually produced.
author: 16luca
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
